verdict.rationale: Loops documents lifecycle workflows built around onboarding, activation, upgrade, and winback emails, with an API/agent layer that can 'add, branch, edit, or delete nodes' in workflow graphs and trigger them via events — covering the branching and multi-step lifecycle automation core of the story. However, there is no explicit documentation of delay/wait steps or exit-rule configuration, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of the visual workflow builder itself. Missing for 10: explicit delay-step documentation, explicit exit-rule/goal documentation, independent user corroboration of building branching workflows.
